title: PageInfo
description: The JSON blob returned by page_info. Every field is always present. This is documentation, kept in sync by hand with the PageInfoJson struct in src/lib.rs, not something validated against at runtime.

width.description: Page width in points. The pixel width render_page would produce at x_scale 1.0 and no explicit width override, i.e. hayro's Page::render_dimensions() - already accounts for the page's /Rotate entry (swapped for a 90/270 degree rotation).

height.description: Page height in points. Same derivation as width, via render_dimensions().

rotation.description: The page's /Rotate entry, normalized to this range.

media_box.description: The page's /MediaBox (inherited from an ancestor /Pages node and defaulted per spec if absent, same as hayro does internally). Unrotated, unlike width/height above.

crop_box.description: The page's /CropBox, same inheritance/defaulting as media_box (defaults to media_box itself if absent). Not intersected with media_box, and unrotated, unlike width/height above.

rect.description: A rectangle in unrotated PDF user-space points, with x0<=x1 and y0<=y1.
